nom: COOLA Classic Face Organic Sunscreen Lotion SPF 30 - Cucumber

avis.texte: I used this years ago and loved it, so when I was in the market for a new facial sunscreen I bought a sample to try again. So glad I only got a sample size. It's hard to work into the skin, greasy the second I sweat, and burns my eyes. No thank you.

I wish I had returned this because this product because, unfortunately, it made me pimple breakouts every single time I used it. I'm careful to check if products are non-comedogenic, but even then there is no guarantee. This sunscreen is lightweight and feels great on the skin with a nice, healthy glow — but steer clear if you tend to break out easily or have a history of acne. This now sits at the bottom of the sunscreen stack :(

PERFECT! i cannot praise this product enough. i have oily, acne-prone skin and this is the only sunscreen that hasn't made me breakout. the bottle has lasted me a very long time too. can't recommend enough!

I had a sample that used on vacation, and it was love at first sight. More than the spf, the moisturizer smells refreshing (I decided to purchase the exact Cucumber full size) and makes my skin incredibly soft and not at all greasy. I think it helped my pores. Honestly I'm obsessed. I tried to buy in store, but all 4 bottles were expired and the staff told me I could use my coupon and order in store but have it shipped free to my home. So kudos to that policy, and that is exactly what happened. I have already told my BFF how amazing this product is, and definitely see it being a repeat purchase.

I like to do a daily spf after my skin care because my skin is prone to burning. This sunscreen is cool and easily absorbs without leaving the skin feeling sticky or greasy. A lot of times sunscreen will leave you looking oily or shiny but with this product its not an issue! Very nice livhtweight scent not overpowering. The only thing I wish was different wohld be the time its lasts before you need to reapply. COOLAs body sunscreens are 80 minutes but their face products are only 40 minutes

I used Coola cucumber face sunscreen previously and liked it for its lightweight texture and matte finish. Loved how my skin looked day to day and also how my skin felt. Needed to replace my tube as I've been using daily sunscreen and thought I should get another tube so bought this thinking it would be the same. But it's not. It is greasy and mak s my skin look awful on my Zoom meetings. I realize they changed the formula and i wont be buying Coola again.

I wish this worked for me. For reference i have combo fair neutral skin. Within an hour my whole face was super shiny and greasy. I even tried using a setting spray after i used it to try and create a barrier but no. I have to powder my face every hour. You will probably like it if you have dry skin.

avis.titre: Summer time fun in the sun!
avis.texte: A friend recommended this after I was telling her about how my current & previous face sunscreens kept giving me little white heads & random pink blotchy spots. So far none of that has happened with this one & that's great for this delicate flower!
I've tried less expensive sunscreens, but I keep coming back to Coola!

I used this product while on vacation for a week at the beach. I do not have acne prone skin and pimples are very uncommon for me. However, after using this product for a week, I have pimples and clogged pores all over my face. Not recommended.
Goes on with a dry feel, and doesn't make skin feel super heavy/greasy as the day goes on. Very good daily sunscreen.

avis.titre: Maybe under makeup or mixed w/ foundation in winter.
avis.texte: I don't normally review things right away. but with this purchase, I did just that. I loved it at first, it was light weight and smelled nice. However, over time I started to notice how shiny it made me. It also, without fail, gives me mini breakouts every time I use it. I don't even like the smell anymore tbh it reminds me of stale mesquite pods. It's somewhat usable in the winter but this product just doesn't work for me. I have combination skin and live in a dry rot Phoenix.

avis.titre: Not what it used to be
avis.texte: This used to have nice ingredients like organic evening primrose oil, açaí fruit oil, orange fruit water and now it's just cheap oils like rapeseed and safflower oil. The SPF is still good, but everything else is not.
I'm normally not one to complain about products being greasy because my face is really dry and I don't mind it sometimes but this was way way to greasy it made me feel gross.

avis.titre: Great smell & consistency... but full of chemicals
avis.texte: I got this in a free sample bag from Ulta and I loved it so much. The smell and the consistency of the product are so nice... and it said it was Organic which was a bonus for me too. I didn't even think to check the back for ingredients on an Organic product...my mom happened to look at it and noticed it was full of chemicals. Avobenzone, Homosalate, Octisalate and Octocrylene are all chemicals that are on the FDA's list of most harmful sunscreen ingredients. I really wanted to love this, but I won't be using it anymore after learning what's in it.
Not sure what happened. Definite labeled Cucumber, but the scent is completely absent.
I really love this product! Light weight, goes on nicely, non greasy, and smells good! The fragrance is light and not overwhelming. I gave it 4 stars because of the price. It's a bit pricey.

The smell was pleasant and it blended in alright, but overall this was disappointing. My face still got burnt (and I don't burn easily at all!) and my skin felt stickier and stickier and got shinier and shinier as the day went on.

It works well as an SPF but I don't really care for it. The smell doesn't really appeal to me and I feel like it lives my face very sticky and shiny. In comparison I loved the Dermalogica Prism Protection SPF but for half the price this gets the job done.

A couple years ago I received a sample of it a subscription box and I absolutely loved it. I rediscovered it and cannot get enough. It smells great and feels fresh. It also doesn't leave a white cast or skin feeling greasy. It feels so light, it doesn't even feel like I'm wearing anything on my face. My only problem with it is that the product is slightly hard to squeeze out so I recommended poking the dispensing hole to make it bigger!

It's a lovely sunscreen with a light-weight texture. I do really like it for the winter time as it gives me a nice boost of moisture and a layer of glowy-ness. But I don't think this would work for me in the summer when I get oiler, I think this would make me borderline greasy. It does layer really nicely under makeup though and it gives your foundation a natural glowing-from-within effect without the shimmer. So that's a plus. I know this has a teeny bit of fragrance in it but you can only smell it when you initially put it on. Doesn't bother me.

avis.titre: Leaves my skin red and greasy
avis.texte: Not for me. I apply it to bare skin before and or after moisturizer. I've tried it all different ways. Leaves my skin red all day.

Like two years ago, I tried 7 different sunscreens and I didn't find the perfect for my skin, for that reason I decided to don't use sunscreen anymore until weeks ago I realized I really needed one. I did a research online and found good reviews about this one and decided to give it a try. It's the BEST! I have oily skin and it makes me feel super fresh, no greasy formula and has a good smell. I feel so happy that finally found something perfect for my face. I'll buy this again.
This sunscreen has a delicate fragrance that does not irritate my sensitive skin. It is truly a non-greasy formula. This is the best sunscreen I have ever tried!

I use this product on my face when I'm going out in the sun..it's lightly scented and it feels awesome on my skin no irritation or discomfort. It's not greasy or a white film left after you rub it in. I recommend this product it's a must have. **This review was created through an promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.

I absolutely love this sunscreen! The COOLA Suncare Face Classic Sunscreen SPF 30 in Cucumber is everything I want in a daily SPF—lightweight, non-greasy, and super refreshing. The texture is silky smooth, blending effortlessly into my skin without leaving a white cast (a must for any good sunscreen!).The cucumber scent is subtle and spa-like, making it feel more like a skincare treat than a chore. Plus, it layers beautifully under makeup with zero pilling, which makes my morning routine so much easier. I also appreciate that it's reef-friendly, cruelty-free, and packed with antioxidants to nourish my skin while protecting it.If you're looking for a sunscreen that feels amazing and actually makes you want to wear SPF daily, this is it! Highly recommend! ️This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Absolutely loved this product! The sunscreen is very lightweight. it doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky after applying nor does it make me look super greasy. It does have a slight shine finish, but personally I liked it as it gave my skin a glass skin effect, especially under makeup. It blended very nicely and also held nice under makeup. The sunscreen doesn't have a super strong smell. It was more of a fleeting, refreshing smell. It does have a typically sunscreen smell for the first 5 seconds but it disappears really quickly, so scent wise I honestly don't have anything to complain about. The sunscreen didn't have any whitecast effect at any point of applying it to your skin nor did it have that weird white effect when in contact with water. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

As an aesthetic nurse whose natural palor rivals that of a vampire, I've used and worked with more sunscreens than I can count. Some great, some, well, not so much, but there are SO MANY decent sunscreens, what makes this one stand out? Its supportive ingredients and a delightful texture/sensory experience. I like that the first ingredient is aloe to support skin's resilience during sun exposure, though I can't tell from the ingredient deck if there is enough of the antioxidant-rich natural oils and prickly pear extract to offer significant protection against free radicals. It's lightweight, feels hydrating, and the naturally-derived cucumber scent *actually* smells like cucumbers, not like fake cucumber fragrance. It's a little too light for me to wear as a daily moisturizer, though it functions well over a separate moisturizer and under makeup. I see it as perfect for summer months when I'm oilier, especially because it's water resistant and didn't burn my eyes during a sweaty workout. I'm reviewing it as part of a promotion, but I'm impressed enough that I will buy it before my beach vacation this summer. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Hi, my name is Sinda. I'm 51 years old and have light combination skin. I have been a Coola fan for awhile and was excited to try thissunscreen. I prefer chemicalsunscreens like this over mineralones because they're solightweight and aren't greasy.This just works so much betterfor my combination skin. Thecucumber scent is nice butdissipates very quickly so youwon't walk around smelling likea cucumber.I love that it is 70% organic,cruelty-free and vegan.The turquoise packaging isbeautiful and the tube allows meto dispense the perfect amountfor my needs.The only negative comment Ihave is that it is only SPF30. Igenerally prefer SPF50sunscreens. Not a deal breakerbut hopefully Coola can increasethe SPF in the future.This product was providedfor promotional purposes inexchange for my honest review.Thanks Beautytap and Coola forthe opprtunity to try thisawesome sunscreen! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Overall, I enjoyed this Coola Face Sunscreen in Cucumber. The scent was light and fresh. I immediately assumed that it would be refreshing to wear. The face cream is in wonderful packaging, but came out very thick, much like sunscreen. Applying the cream was easy and it really moisturized my facial skin. The only thing I didn't like, was that it was a bit greasy. It felt heavy on my face and touching my skin, my face almost had an oily feel. So I would recommend with some hesitation. I had zero irritation, however, on my sensitive skin. The sun protection was definitely there, normally I will burn on my nose and I didn't at all while only wearing this on my face. So great for outside exposure! I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I really enjoy this sunscreen! I was surprised by the cucumber scent because I didn't think it would smell EXACTLY like it. So if you hate cucumber then I would try another scent. I have my eyes on the coconut scent for summer! The texture is smooth and creamy and my makeup had no issues with staying power. In the picture I applied some to the back of my wrist so you can see the product after drying, it's basically invisible with a tiny bit of dew when the sun reflects. If you have dry skin like me then I think you will find this soothing, but I can't give advice if you're oily. With all that said I definitely recommend. This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review, but this does not alter my opinion on the product. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Also, its super effective in doing its job. I have never gotten a sunburn using coola products. And that is no lie. It is also at a very very affordable price point. I would highly recommend trying this if you havent tried it yet. Its really really good! Lastly, i just wanted to comment on the cucumber scent, again because it needs to be driven home how good it is. Its so refreshing BRB you will die for this. When you see this one me in the picture below, you will see it left no oily cask at all. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Coola is one my favorite sunscreen brands!! I have been using their sunscreens it every day for almost a year!! So I am always get excited for their new sunscreens additions. I have been this Sunscreen Lotion SPF 30 (Cucumber)for the last two weeks and I love it !! I was worried it could have a strong scent , I personally don't like any scent on my face, it does has a pinch of cucumber scent but the scent completely disappears in seconds after you apply it. I have used at least 10 different sunscreens and this one by far tops it all. I use a lot of tretinoin and I haven't had one sun spot since I switched to this sunscreen. I will definitely bring it with me to my upcoming spring break vacation. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Coola Classic Facial Sunscreen Cucumber is a light-weight, clear, hydrating sunscreen lotion. It has a nice light cucumber scent that is not overwhelming. I like that this product feels hydrating and wears more like a moisturizer than a typical sunscreen. It dries clear and is not greasy or chalky. It wore perfectly both under my makeup and alone. I enjoy that this facial sunscreen contains antioxidants such as Raspberry Seed Oil and Prickly Pear Extract. It also contains Buriti Oil. It also contains 70% organic ingredients. This sunscreen is vegan and cruelty free. It is recommended that you apply this sunscreen 15 minutes before going in the sun. Also, that you reapply every two hours while in the sun, or every 40 minutes while swimming or sweating. Product was received as part of an educational promotion. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Recently I've tried this product of Suncare Face Classic Sunscreen SPF 30 by COOLA and it's my first product to try about this brand and I absolutely recommend it for anyone that is looking for a classic sunscreen face lotion . I love the texture of this product & so easy to applied all over your face , lightweight and most likely it's so refreshing. This is one of my favorite things from this face cream is that smells so good it's refreshing and lightweight. I've been using it for a week already , every morning after washing my face and applying my toner I also applied this face cream and it just gives me a fresh look and I feel good and my skin feels moisturizing all day since I suffer of dry skin & specifically more in the winter time and this has been helping me a lot . Can even complain about the price it's worth it and for the size of the bottle it's perfect price . Is a must have on your skin care routine. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I was able to try this Coola Classic Face Sunscreen Lotion for free for my honest review and I've had great results with using it. It really hydrates my skin while protecting me from the suns harmful rays and it smells really good too. This is the first organic sunscreen I've tried and it's worked way better than any other sunscreen I've used. It makes me feel better about putting it on my skin as well. I haven't experienced any breakouts from using it. There's no greasy residue left on my skin but leaves my skin feeling so soft and moisturized. I'll definitely continue using this brand. I'd also really like to try more of their products just because of them being organic and not having a bunch of chemicals in their products that could potentially harm my body. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Product was received as part of an educational promotion. COOLA's face sunscreen is a game-changer, and I have really enjoyed using this product. It's non-greasy and super hydrating and felt more like a moisturizer than a sunscreen. The subtle cucumber scent is a refreshing start to my day, not overpowering at all. It was easy to throw in my purse and take with me during the day, and I can't wait to take it to the beach or park as the weather gets warmer. My sensitive skin loves it – no irritation, just a healthy glow. Truly a daily essential. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I have really enjoyed this sunscreen! The light scent is really nice and perfect for the summer. The sunscreen is very lightweight and feels nice to wear which isn't common for sunscreens. It feels like I'm just doing skincare. I typically don't apply sunscreen because it's an awful sensory experience (both having it on my face and applying it). This sunscreen is honestly easy to forget is on because of how natural and lightweight it feels. The tube is also really simple, cute, as well as travel friendly. The cucumber scent helps me remember to apply it because I enjoy the scent so that's an added plus! I'm really excited to use this this summer in this Texas sun! I also appreciate that it doesn't leave any white cast and I have pretty tan skin **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This is a very nice, lightweight sunscreen lotion. It's not greasy and doesn't leave a film. The ingredients are good quality and it feels more like a face lotion than a thick sunscreen. My skin feels really soft and hydrated altering applying. The only downside is that I sweat it off quite quickly. I'd recommend this for people that want an everyday face lotion that has sunscreen. This product is not for beach days or more heavy sports activities. The cucumber scent is light and not heavy at all. I appreciate Coola's dedication to making products that are vegan, cruelty free, and made with organic ingredients. Overall I am impressed and will be incorporating it into my daily routine.*Product was received as part of an educational promotion. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: A sunscreen I can wear daily!
avis.texte: Let me start by saying that I'm typically not a fan of sunscreen due to the texture, so I'll try to find products that include spf instead. However, this product had changed that. This does not feel like your typical sunscreen. I actually thought it was a moisturizer with spf originally because it blends perfectly into my skin and is not greasy at all. It also makes my skin feel very soft afterwards, which most sunscreens do not. Another thing to note is that my makeup applies so well over this due to how soft it is. There is no pilling and my skin feels like it can breathe. I know the importance of sunscreen and have been hunting for one that is as lightweight as this. I have to say, this is by far the most comfortable sunscreen I've ever worn. A new daily staple! This product was provided to me for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I have been a loyal user of Coola for years now. I was in complete shock when I was chosen for this round to try out the cucumber scented facial SPF 30 Lotion. Viola's sunscreens don't leave a white cast or residual which is why coola is my favorite. As someone who wears a lot of makeup and gets really oily around her T-zone around half way through the day I have to make sure I use a sunscreen that is noncomedogenic so that it doesn't end up clogging my pores or my blackheads as I wear makeup. I also suffer from hormonal acne every so often. The main reason why I love coola SPF is because the scents are so light and not to potent where you feel like the scent takes or ruins a product for you. For me I am a huge fan of scented products. I will continue to love coola until something prevents me from continuing to use there products. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I'm on my 40s and I'm always on retinol or some sort of active ingredient. For that reason, I need daily sun protection. I do not skip a day, I wear sunscreen religiously. I've tried many different brands over the years, and only a few that I'm comfortable with. Throughout those years, Coola has become a beloved brand of mine. I've gone through some many bottles of their different sunscreen formulations, from lips to scalp, you name it! Now of course, the Classic Face Sunscreen Lotion (cucumber) which has become one of my favorite everyday sunscreens. I love everything about it. The lightweight, non-greasy formula, the subtle cucumber scent, the fact that is very comfortable to wear, everything!There's no white cast. The lotion comes out white from the bottle, but turns completely clear after applying it on the skin. It blends in perfectly with any skintone. I've already recommended it to friends and family. I trust and love this brand so much, and the Classic Face Lotion Sunscreen didn't disappoint. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I'm Carolyn and I've been an esthetician for half my life. So I know that one of the skin's biggest enemies is UV rays. It's been proven that upwards of 85% of aging comes from unprotected sun exposure. And I'm as pale as pearls so it's been a personal journey to keep my skin protected.As an esthetician and consumer I've always leaned towards mineral elements in sun protection products as they deflect. Chemical sunscreens allow the rays to enter the skin but chemically change them to heat to protect against damage. Those have usually lead to inflammation and redness in my skin.I've reviewed and avidly used Coola products because I was a fan of their mineral based products. I was exited to try this sunscreen and loved the fresh cucumber scent. It's organic, but I was surprised to find that it was a chemical sunscreen. Upon further research I found that it does not contain the chemicals that cause me inflammation and irritation, Oxybenzone and Octinoxate. Brava Coola for producing a chemical sunscreen that is protective and nourishes the skin. It also contains active plant botanicals that protect the skin from free radicals.I love that this sunscreen does not have the white masking or typical sunscreen aroma. It's a crisp, fresh cucumber scent. It's the perfect weight to apply over my daytime skincare regime. It's light, but I felt it sealed in my serums and moisturizer. Helping to keep my skin feeling hydrated and supple all day, not cloaked. And it's an unexpected fabulous ma

I wish this worked for me. For reference i have combo fair neutral skin. Within an hour my whole face was super shiny and greasy. I even tried using a setting spray after i used it to try and create a barrier but no. I have to powder my face every hour. You will probably like it if you have dry skin.

avis.titre: Summer time fun in the sun!
avis.texte: A friend recommended this after I was telling her about how my current & previous face sunscreens kept giving me little white heads & random pink blotchy spots. So far none of that has happened with this one & that's great for this delicate flower!
I can wear this cream every day over my other skin care. Light weight, smells good. I have a very sensitive skin and I had no bad reaction after using this product.
I've tried less expensive sunscreens, but I keep coming back to Coola!
This is the best sunscreen my family uses, not greasy, does not dry your skin, does not flake, and does not irritate sensitive skin. The best sunscreen I tried for my son too

avis.titre: Great face protection, not as big of a fan of smell
avis.texte: Tried this as an alternative scent as I have previously used the 'White Tea' scent. Still loved the lightweight feel of the sunscreen, but the smell was just OK and I wasn't a huge fan.
First time user & really love the texture as it is very light and is nice under makeup. Excellent protection! Save your face!
Feels so great on my skin! I mix in my Vitamin C serum with it and apply it every morning. Also great to prime my skin for my makeup!

I used this product while on vacation for a week at the beach. I do not have acne prone skin and pimples are very uncommon for me. However, after using this product for a week, I have pimples and clogged pores all over my face. Not recommended.
Love your products. Nice fragrance and my skin feels nourished after use. I really love your tinted lip sunscreen. I wear it all the time
I love this sunscreen. It has a light feel (not greasy), a light and pleasant fragrance and does the work a sunscreen should.

I was so excited to find a sunscreen that I could wear all day that did not cause my face to break out. It's lightly scented but not something you smell all day. I love that it doesn't leave my face greasy feeling. Would recommend 100%!
Absolutely love it! You must try it for yourself to understand what I mean. I've never tried anything like it. It does and says everything it is.
I love the refreshing scent and it is not greasy at all. I work out in a cemetery and it keeps me refreshed and protected from the rays all day! I swear by this stuff!
Goes on with a dry feel, and doesn't make skin feel super heavy/greasy as the day goes on. Very good daily sunscreen.
Finally, a sunblock my skin likes! I've been using it for months and have no problem wearing it every day
The smell was amazing. It did not cause breakouts and did not make my eyes tear! I have already bought more for the summer. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Maybe under makeup or mixed w/ foundation in winter.
avis.texte: I don't normally review things right away. but with this purchase, I did just that. I loved it at first, it was light weight and smelled nice. However, over time I started to notice how shiny it made me. It also, without fail, gives me mini breakouts every time I use it. I don't even like the smell anymore tbh it reminds me of stale mesquite pods. It's somewhat usable in the winter but this product just doesn't work for me. I have combination skin and live in a dry rot Phoenix.
I received this product and tried it for a week and it was really great. I wish you continued success. Have a nice day.
